Default code language annotation on blocks without lang attribute

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"code_language\":\"python\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<pre><code>def hello(): pass</code></pre>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
